end.summary:
Identified 11 as eleven sticks, noting a bundle counts as one object.
Represented 14 as one bundle and four loose sticks after prompting.
Represented 15 as one bundle and five loose sticks.
Asked how one bundle represents ten; teach-back was not passed.
Lesson ended at the child's request after about 1 minute.
end.parentNote: Asha practised showing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and extra loose sticks. Saanvi used the method for 14 and 15 after the example, but mixed up the bundle as “one thing” rather than ten sticks, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, make one group of 10 buttons or pencils and add loose ones to build 11–20, saying “ten and some more” each time.
